title: Add desktop launcher smoke test with clean shutdown
acceptance_criteria: `python3 .tmp/local-smoke-tests/desktop_smoke.py` exits 0 when the desktop launcher or its documented local fallback is exercised through localhost-only checks.
The smoke test clearly documents whether it is validating the pywebview launcher path, a packaged launcher path, or a safer repo-local fallback path, and why.
The smoke test avoids remote network calls and verifies readiness using local HTTP checks only.
The smoke test always closes spawned launcher and server processes before exit, even after timeout or readiness failure.
